name: Snoutics
tagline: The data layer for everything with a heartbeat and a leash.
positioning: Snoutics is the pet-data infrastructure that powers vet networks, insurers, and retail giants — one API for the whole species, not a spreadsheet named final_v3.

hero.h1: Pet data infrastructure that refuses to roll over.
hero.sub: Every microchip scan, claim, vaccine record, and grooming no-show — unified into one API. Your integration team stops herding CSVs and starts shipping. The dogs stay confused, as intended.

features.title: One profile per animal
features.description: Deduped, cross-referenced pet identities across every clinic, shelter, and store you touch. No more three Bellas that are secretly the same Labrador.

features.title: Claims that clear themselves
features.description: Route insurance and warranty claims through a rules engine that reads vet notes so your adjusters don't have to squint at handwriting from 2011.

features.title: Real-time species telemetry
features.description: Ingest collar, feeder, and kennel-sensor events at 40k/sec. Alert on the anomalies that matter, ignore the ones that are just a cat being a cat.

features.title: Audit trail with teeth
features.description: Every record change is signed, timestamped, and reversible. SOC 2, GDPR, and the one auditor who trusts nothing all leave satisfied.

features.title: Fleet-scale onboarding
features.description: Spin up a new region of 900 clinics in a weekend. Bulk import, schema mapping, and dedupe run while your ops team sleeps.

features.title: Dashboards leadership reads
features.description: Retention, claim velocity, and per-location health in views your CFO actually opens instead of forwarding to an analyst.

testimonials.quote: We had eleven pet databases and zero agreement on how many cats we insured. Snoutics gave us one number, and it was somehow lower than any of the eleven. Cheaper too.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitlock

testimonials.quote: Migrating 1,300 clinics onto one record system should have taken a year. It took a quarter. Our vets stopped complaining, which is how I knew it worked.
testimonials.name: Rafael Ibáñez

testimonials.quote: The telemetry pipeline flagged a feeder malfunction across 40 stores before a single support ticket. Usage billing means we only pay when the dogs are actually eating.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadkarni
